posts.title: Jetbrains Rider vs Webstorm
posts.description: For the last five or so years, I’ve been using Jetbrains Rider as my primary IDE for C# work, and Webstorm for any Javascript, Typescript, and NodeJS work. Since Rider has most of the Webstorm features built in, along with Datagrip features, and much more , it initially seemed perfect to consolidate all my work into Rider, since my work is a fairly even mix of C#, Typescript, and Javascript.
